distribution.method: Git dependency with an install-time prepare build

checks.method: npm install of the Git dependency in an empty temporary directory
checks.details: The prepare script ran npm run build. node_modules/dsh-plugin-claude-code/dist/index.js existed. The package entry imported with the exports CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ROUTE, Config, apply, inject, and name. npm installed 125 packages.

checks.method: npm pack and npm pack --dry-run --json, then inspect the archive
checks.details: The archive had 55 entries: 52 files under dist/, package.json, README.md, and cordis.patch.yml. It had no source, test, fixture, evidence, credential, or private data file.

checks.method: DSH_HOME=<temporary> dsh plugin --profile acceptance add <Git spec> on a new profile
checks.details: The command exited 1 with ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED. It printed the exact allowBuilds key for the fetched commit and named the profile pnpm-workspace.yaml. The failed run left the profile package.json without the dependency.

checks.method: Add the printed allowBuilds key to the profile pnpm-workspace.yaml and repeat the add
checks.details: The run built the package in the fetched copy with npm (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json). It installed the plugin and added the dependency and the bundle to the profile package.json.
The composed tree has a dsh-plugin-claude-code layer and the claude-code-session entry. The entry is not disabled.

checks.method: Fresh isolated DSH_HOME. Create the shipped headless profile with --dump-config. Run dsh plugin --profile headless add github:shantanugoel/dsh-plugin-claude-code.
checks.details: The first run exited 1 with ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED. It printed the exact allowBuilds key for the fetched GitHub archive, pinned to commit dd952ad9b1200ca7c13a5254ab8e3c363a2215e2. After the profile pnpm-workspace.yaml contained that key, the second run fetched the archive, ran the prepare build (npm install and tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) in the fetched copy, and installed the plugin. The profile dependency is github:shantanugoel/dsh-plugin-claude-code. The installed package has README.md, cordis.patch.yml, package.json, and dist/ only.

github_spec_check.profile: headless, created from the shipped template in a fresh isolated DSH_HOME
github_spec_check.first_attempt: exit 1, ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED, allowBuilds key printed for the codeload archive pinned to the commit
github_spec_check.second_attempt: exit 0, prepare and tsc ran in the fetched archive, plugin installed
github_spec_check.dump_config: the composed tree contains the dsh-plugin-claude-code layer and the enabled claude-code-session entry

proven: A Git dependency install of the package runs the prepare build and produces an importable bundle.
The packed archive contains the compiled files and no private file.
An isolated dsh profile refuses the first Git install with a clear build-approval message and the exact key.
After the profile allows that key, the plugin installs and the composed profile lists the route.
not_proven: The desktop app build-approval flow; it was not run.
The plugin module import and route use during a boot; --dump-config composes the route but does not run plugin JavaScript. The first task in issue #13 covers it.
A live model turn through the installed plugin; this issue sends no model prompt.
